decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully captures the new sliding relationship and rod-nut retention method and removes the obsolete POS 4 relationship.
The bushing arrangement does not necessarily change any specified shaft dimension, stock, keyway, thread, or bushing-space width.
The bushing guidance and retention change does not alter the established premachining, welding, or final-machining sequence.
The source changes the bushing arrangement but does not change its CuSn12 material or any other material specification.
The bushing arrangement is independent of the specified 45-degree angle between lug hole axes.
Changing the depicted mechanical arrangement does not alter the assembly-based drawing-numbering rule.
The source specifies mechanical content to depict but does not change the requirement to provide a complete manufacturing drawing set.
The requirement to deliver a 3D assembly model remains unchanged; the configuration itself is already owned by the mechanical-design Requirements.
The revised bushing arrangement does not change the applicable ČSN/EN standards or template conditions.
The source does not establish or change any specific dimension or annotation rule for the technical drawings.
